name: PicMonkey
description_en:
PicMonkey is a photo/design service with templates, touch-up, image editing, cloud project storage and plan-dependent brand/team tools. Users can create and save projects in Hub before paying, but the pricing FAQ says downloading or sharing requires a subscription. Free creation should therefore not be represented as a free finished-output plan.

It fits branded social/marketing design where cloud revision and reusable brand assets matter. Pro adds background removal, PDF export and custom fonts with platform/trial conditions; Business adds collaboration. Asset licensing, team-seat requirements and backup remain separate checks rather than automatic consequences of an “unlimited storage” plan.
description_zh:
PicMonkey是照片/设计服务，包含模板、修饰、图片编辑、云项目及按套餐提供的品牌/团队工具。用户可先创作并存到Hub，但价格FAQ表示下载或分享需订阅，因此免费创作不能表示为免费成品输出方案。

它适合重视云修改和品牌复用的社交/营销设计。Pro增加去背景、PDF和自定义字体，但有平台/试用条件，Business增加协作。素材许可、团队席位及备份需独立核查，不能由“无限存储”自动推定。

sections.title_en: Edit a photo, preserve the project and deliver deliberately
sections.title_zh: 编辑照片、保留项目并明确交付
sections.en:
A documentation-based promotional workflow is to open a photo, use editing/touch-up or a template, apply the approved brand assets and retain the editable Hub project. The pricing page distinguishes ongoing creation/storage from download/share entitlement. Choose JPG/PNG for image delivery or eligible web PDF when that is the actual requirement; a stored project is not an exported file.

Editorial fit: small teams can evaluate templates, reusable brand colors/fonts and revision across desktop/mobile. Check current mobile feature parity rather than assuming everything available on web is in the app. If a client needs a layered source document outside PicMonkey, verify its export path first. No editable-project interchange format or standalone self-hosting capability was established.
sections.zh:
基于文档的宣传流程是打开照片，使用编辑/修饰或模板，加入获批品牌素材并保留Hub可编辑项目。价格页区分持续创作/存储与下载/分享资格，应按需求选JPG/PNG或符合条件的网页PDF，存下项目不等于已导出文件。

编辑建议：小团队可评估模板、品牌颜色/字体及桌面/手机修改，但应检查移动功能，不假定网页所有能力在App都有。如果客户需PicMonkey之外的分层源文档，应先核实导出路线，本文未建立项目交换格式或独立自托管能力。

sections.title_en: Automatic removal still needs edge inspection
sections.title_zh: 自动去背景仍需修边检查
sections.en:
The [background-removal page](https://www.picmonkey.com/photo-editor/background-remover) says to open a photo and click Remove Background, then refine edges with the eraser/paintbrush. A user can add a color/photo background or an outline. This is a relevant workflow for a product cutout or profile graphic, but hair, semitransparency and fine product edges need output inspection rather than reliance on one-click accuracy claims.

The feature is Pro/subscription-gated, including supported mobile access; the price page explicitly excludes background removal and premium stock from the trial. It also subjects background removal to fair use without a numeric allowance in the read material. Confirm the actual eligibility before scheduling a batch. No automatic cutout, manual correction, mobile export or fair-use limit was tested.
sections.zh:
[去背景页](https://www.picmonkey.com/photo-editor/background-remover)说明打开照片后点Remove Background，再用橡皮/画笔修边，可加颜色/照片背景或描边，适合商品抠图或头像。但发丝、半透明及细商品边需看实际输出，不能依赖一键准确宣传。

此功能限Pro/相应订阅，也包含受支持移动访问；价格页明确试用不含去背景和高级图库，并把去背景列为公平使用但未给数值额度。批任务前应确认资格。本文未测自动抠图、修边、移动导出或公平使用上限。

sections.title_en: Plan, platform and trial are three separate conditions
sections.title_zh: 套餐、平台及试用三种条件分别看
sections.en:
The read [pricing page](https://www.picmonkey.com/pricing) lists Basic with 1 GB Hub storage and JPG/PNG; Pro with unlimited storage, Smart Resize, one brand kit, background removal and premium stock, plus web-only PDF export and custom-font uploads. Business adds multiple brand kits, searchable tags and collaboration/permissions for teams of two or more. A free mobile app has premium features under subscription; this does not remove the desktop output paywall.

The normal browser and HTML both lacked numeric price cards, so no legacy dollar amount is repeated. A seven-day trial is promoted; its Pro stock/cutout exclusions mean it cannot validate every paid workflow. The governing terms describe a Team Subscription of three or more seats, unlike the current two-plus collaboration label, so minimum seats and contract scope need clarification. Team trials are separately excluded under that terms section.
sections.zh:
实读[价格页](https://www.picmonkey.com/pricing)列Basic含1GB Hub及JPG/PNG；Pro为无限存储、Smart Resize、1个品牌工具包、去背景及高级图库，另有仅网页的PDF和字体上传；Business增多品牌、可搜索标签及两人以上团队协作/权限。免费移动App部分高级功能仍需订阅，不取消桌面输出付费条件。

正常浏览器及HTML均缺数值价格卡片，因此不沿用旧金额。网站宣传七天试用，但Pro图库/抠图排除意味着不能验证全部付费流程。条款Team Subscription写至少3席，与当前两人以上协作标签不同，最低席位和合同范围需确认，该条款另排除团队试用。

sections.en:
The pricing FAQ says cancellation leaves the account active until the next renewal date. Terms distinguish billing/cancellation and regional cooling-off provisions; outside applicable exceptions they exclude partial-month/year refunds. Do not treat “cancel anytime” as a universal money-back guarantee. Exact price/currency, taxes, annual commitment and current trial conversion need confirmation at checkout.

The team terms let administrators assign/remove seats and charge additional seats immediately on a prorated basis, with seats otherwise renewing like ordinary subscriptions. Invited collaborators and a paid account/seat are distinct access choices. Verify which projects/material the intended recipient can see before sharing confidential client images. No account, card, invitation, seat change or cancellation was performed.
sections.zh:
价格FAQ表示取消后账户有效到下个续费日。条款区分账期/取消及地区冷静期，适用例外之外不退部分月/年费用，不能把“随时取消”当统一退款保证。具体价格/币种、税费、年约及试用转付费需结账确认。

团队条款让管理员分配/移除席位，增加席位立即按比例收费，其余按普通订阅续费。邀请协作者与付费账户/席位是不同访问方式，分享客户机密图前应检查接收人可见项目/素材。本研究未执行账户、银行卡、邀请、席位或取消。

sections.title_en: Stock, collaboration and backup have material limits
sections.title_zh: 图库、协作及备份有实际限制
sections.en:
The [terms](https://www.picmonkey.com/legal/tos) retain provider software/material IP and user upload ownership while licensing content for service operation and collaboration. Provider content has composition/acknowledgment conditions. Getty/Shutterstock stock cannot be extracted as standalone files, used as logos/trademarks, retail products or on-demand customization under the stated restrictions. A premium stock library is not unrestricted stock ownership.

The [privacy page](https://www.picmonkey.com/legal) says uploads are not public, except collaborators can view shared-project material. This is a vendor policy, not a tested access boundary. Terms encourage the user’s own backups and allow content deletion, explicitly saying PicMonkey is not a backup service. Keep originals and permitted exports independently of Hub. Asset-specific/client usage, current retention/retrieval and exact team contract remain unresolved; no image/upload/export/access or recovery testing was performed.
sections.zh:
[条款](https://www.picmonkey.com/legal/tos)保留提供方软件/素材知识产权及用户上传所有权，同时授予服务运营和协作许可。提供方素材附组合/确认署名条件，Getty/Shutterstock图库不得拆成独立文件，且对标志/商标、零售商品及按需定制有限制，高级图库不等于无限制拥有图库。

[隐私页](https://www.picmonkey.com/legal)表示上传不公开，但协作者可见共享项目材料；这是厂商政策，不是权限实测。条款建议自行备份并保留删除内容的权利，明确PicMonkey不是备份服务。应在Hub外保存原图及允许的输出。素材/客户专属用途、当前保留/取回及团队合同仍未解决，未执行图片/上传/导出/权限或恢复测试。
